full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white screenprint shows an extreme close crop of a face, with one dark eye near the upper center and most of the head cut by the image edges. The left edge removes part of the nose and mouth, while the lower edge cuts through the chin and neck. On the right, dark hair or a broad inked shadow curves beside the eye and cheek, surrounded by a pale rough field. The eye is heavily shaded beneath a thick eyebrow, its gaze directed outward and slightly down. The cheek and nose are built from grainy gray ink rather than smooth photographic shading, with small speckles visible in the lighter zones. Across both light and dark areas, many thin scratches run diagonally, horizontally, and in arcs. Some seem to interrupt the printed ink like white gouges, while others are black dragged marks on the pale ground. Broad charcoal masses collect around the hair and beneath the face, creating a striking contrast with the nearly white cheek and right-side paper. The image occupies nearly the whole square, leaving little conventional background or setting. Its viewpoint is frontal but cropped so tightly that the face becomes an arrangement of fragmented textures and tones. Light falls from the left front, brightening the forehead, cheek, and side of the nose, while the eye socket and far side remain black. Rough registration, grain, and abrasion give the surface a physical printed quality rather than the seamless finish of a photograph. The overall composition is tense and immediate, balancing one recognizable eye with a dense web of distressed marks and severe monochrome contrast.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白丝网印画极近距离地裁切一张脸，一只深色眼睛位于上方中央附近，头部大半被画边截断。左边缘裁去一部分鼻子和嘴，下边缘切过下巴与颈部。右侧，深色头发或宽阔墨影在眼与脸颊旁弯曲，周围是浅色粗糙区域。眼睛在浓眉下被厚重阴影围住，目光朝画外并微微向下。脸颊与鼻子由带颗粒的灰墨而非平滑照片明暗构成，浅色区域可见细小墨点。许多细刮痕斜向、横向及弧形地跨越亮处与暗处。有些像白色划口切断印墨，有些则是浅色底上拖出的黑线。宽阔炭黑体块聚在发部和面部下方，与近白的脸颊及右侧纸面形成醒目反差。图像几乎占满方形，不留通常意义的背景或场景。视点近于正面，却裁得极紧，使面容变成破碎肌理与明暗的组合。光从左前方照亮额头、脸颊与鼻侧，眼窝和远侧则保持黑暗。粗糙套印、颗粒和磨损使表面具有实体印刷质地，而非照片的无缝完成面。整体构图紧张而直接，以一只可辨认的眼睛平衡密密刮伤痕迹与严厉的单色反差。
style_prompt_en: A distressed monochrome screenprint combines broad charcoal ink masses, pale open areas, and coarse midtone grain. Abraded white scratches cut through dark deposits, while dragged black lines cross lighter regions at varied angles. Boundaries are irregular and sometimes partly erased, creating urgency without losing the main large-scale value structure. The tight crop gives one compact dark focal area disproportionate visual weight. Left-front brightness meets deep lateral shadow, and the surface carries visible speckle, imperfect transfer, and rubbed marks rather than smooth gradients. The composition feels raw, graphic, and tactile, with tension between recognizable tonal form and disruptive print damage.
style_prompt_zh: 磨损感单色丝网印画把宽阔炭黑墨块、浅色开放区域和粗粒中间调结合起来。磨出的白色刮痕切过深墨层，拖拽的黑线从不同角度横穿浅色区。边界不规则，有时部分被擦去，带来急迫感，却不损失大尺度明暗结构。紧密裁切让一个紧凑深色焦点获得超出面积的视觉重量。左前方亮处接到深侧影，表面可见墨点、不完美转印和擦痕，而不是平滑渐变。构图粗粝、图形化且可触，可辨明暗形体与破坏性的印刷磨损之间充满张力。
theme_en: A scratched monochrome screenprint of a closely cropped face
theme_zh: 一道道刮痕覆盖着近距离面容的单色丝网印画
name: Screenprint
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
